headline: WoRD: Diffusion-Based Posterior Inference for Online Goal Recognition
body: Goal recognition is the task of inferring an agent's intended goal from its observed behavior. Most existing work focuses on high-level symbolic recognition, abstracting away the continuous motion through which agents reach their goal.
caption:
WoRD: Diffusion-Based Posterior Inference for Online Goal Recognition

Goal recognition is the task of inferring an agent's intended goal from its observed behavior. Most existing work focuses on high-level symbolic recognition, abstracting away the continuous motion through which agents reach their goal.

Source: arXiv
